It seems the fix-pr route https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/actions/runs/26652838822 still does not have correct deployment step?

Now I have enough context to write the review.

## Notes

- This PR is **already merged**; the user's comment arrived just before the merge landed.
- The referenced run [26652838822](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/actions/runs/26652838822) confirms the symptom: 17 steps visible, no "Deploy preview" step at all. That run executed an older fix-pr workflow (before surge support was added) — the step was literally absent, not just skipped.
- No rubrics are present to score against, so rubric verdict is N/A.

## Findings

- **INFO:** PR #55 correctly targets all three root causes identified in the referenced run:
  1. **`environment: preview` missing from `fix-pr` job** → secrets `SURGE_LOGIN`/`SURGE_TOKEN` were never injected → deploy step silently failed. PR #55 adds `environment: preview` at line 115 of `agent-fix-pr.yml`. ✅
  2. **Domain used `PREVIEW_ISSUE_N`** (extracted from branch name), which was removed from scope. PR #55 switches to `PR_NUMBER` (already available as `inputs.pr_number`). ✅
  3. **Silent failure on empty credentials** — PR #55 adds an explicit `::error::` guard before the `surge` call in all three workflows. ✅

- **INFO:** The same `environment: preview` fix was applied consistently to all three affected jobs (`implement`, `fix-pr`, `teardown-preview`). The teardown also switched from branch-name regex parsing to the event-native `github.event.pull_request.number`, which is simpler and collision-free. ✅

- **INFO:** `agent-implement.yml` gained an extra guard `steps.pr.outputs.pr_number != ''` on the deploy condition, preventing a deploy when no PR was created. ✅

- **WARNING:** The "Check preview label from branch" step in `fix-pr` only matches branches named `implement-issue-N`. Manual or non-agent branches won't get a preview even if the PR has a `preview` label. This was pre-existing behavior, not introduced by PR #55, and may be intentional.

- **INFO:** No content files were touched — all changes are workflow-only, low blast radius.

## Final Rubric Verdict

N/A

---

**Bottom line:** The fix is complete and correct for the described problem. The referenced run showing a missing deploy step is explained by it predating the PR #55 changes — future `fix-pr` runs on `preview`-labeled issues will now reach the deploy step with valid credentials and a PR-number-based domain.

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

I have all the context needed. Both reviews agree, no existing inline threads to manage. I'll now produce the synthesis.

## Summary of PR/Issue

PR #55 implements [Issue #54](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/issues/54) by backporting Surge.sh preview-deployment fixes from a feature branch into the three core agent workflows (`agent-implement.yml`, `agent-fix-pr.yml`, `agent-branch-cleanup.yml`). The two root bugs were: (1) `environment: preview` was absent from the `fix-pr` job, so `SURGE_LOGIN`/`SURGE_TOKEN` were never injected and deploys silently failed; and (2) the Surge domain used `PREVIEW_ISSUE_N` (a variable removed from scope), which needed to be replaced with `PR_NUMBER`. The PR is already merged. The user's concern about run [26652838822](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/actions/runs/26652838822) showing no "Deploy preview" step is explained by that run predating the merge — the step was literally absent from `main` at the time.

## Review

Both reviewers agree the implementation is correct and addresses the described failures precisely. The changes are internally consistent across all three workflows and the fix is complete.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Pre-existing: branch-name gate in fix-pr | WARNING | "Check preview label from branch" matches only `implement-issue-N` branches; manual/non-agent branches won't get previews even with the `preview` label. Pre-existing and likely intentional. |
| Orphaned old-style previews | INFO | Old `augmented-mind-preview-{issue}.surge.sh` deployments cannot be auto-torn down; a one-time manual `npx surge teardown` is needed. Acceptable migration cost. |
| PR_NUMBER inheritance inconsistency | INFO | `agent-fix-pr.yml` inherits `PR_NUMBER` from job-level `env`, while `agent-implement.yml` sets it explicitly in the step. Both work correctly; minor readability mismatch only. |

## Progress

- Both BLOCKING pre-merge issues are resolved and merged:
  - `environment: preview` added to all three affected jobs (`implement`, `fix-pr`, `teardown-preview`)
  - Domain variable corrected from `PREVIEW_ISSUE_N` → `PR_NUMBER` across all three workflows
- Explicit credential guard (`::error::`) added before `surge` calls to prevent silent failures
- `agent-implement.yml` gained an extra guard (`steps.pr.outputs.pr_number != ''`) preventing a spurious deploy when no PR was created
- Teardown migrated from regex branch-name parsing to `github.event.pull_request.number` (simpler and collision-free)
- Agent memory for Surge.sh subdomain pattern is already up to date
- The user's referenced failing run is explained and not caused by PR #55

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Pre-existing: branch-name gate in fix-pr</summary>

**Cause:** The "Check preview label from branch" step in `agent-fix-pr.yml` uses a pattern match against the branch name (`implement-issue-N`) to decide whether to deploy a preview. This was already the behavior before PR #55.

**Candidate solutions:** Replace the branch-name regex with a direct check against PR labels via the GitHub API or via a `preview` label on the triggering event. This would generalize the gate correctly.

**Comments:** Both reviewers flagged this as pre-existing. It may be intentional (previews only for agent-implemented PRs). No action required for this PR, but worth tracking as a follow-up.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Orphaned old-style previews</summary>

**Cause:** Teardown now constructs the Surge domain using `github.event.pull_request.number`. Any preview deployed before this fix used `augmented-mind-preview-{issue}.surge.sh` and will not match the new teardown logic.

**Candidate solutions:** One-time manual: `npx surge teardown augmented-mind-preview-{issue}.surge.sh` for any known lingering previews.

**Comments:** Acceptable migration cost; no automation blocker.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step

`NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` — all blocking issues are resolved and merged; remaining findings are pre-existing behavior, migration cleanup, or cosmetic inconsistencies that don't require a branch change.

## Final Verdict

**SHIP**

## Action Items

- [ ] (Optional) Generalize the preview gate in `agent-fix-pr.yml` to check PR labels directly rather than matching `implement-issue-N` branch names, so non-agent branches with a `preview` label also get a preview deployment.
- [ ] (Optional) Manually run `npx surge teardown` for any `augmented-mind-preview-{issue}.surge.sh` domains deployed before PR #55 merged.
